title: notes-to-self: sprint tasks + errands
content:
Morning quick notes - Maya (Wed 2026-03-04)

Top of mind
- block time 2pm-4pm for benchmarks + profiling (quiet window)
- follow up with Ravi on mixed-precision rollout plan (see JIRA-2984)
- confirm infra quota increase for dedicated pool (billing team)

Today:
- 9:00 sync w/ SRE: brief on rollout canary thresholds (prep slides, 3 bullets)
- 10:30 implementation review w/ Evan: address loop in batching logic (PR #412)
- 11:30 1:1 w/ manager: status on roadmap, bring up quota ask and hiring ask
- 14:00-16:00 quiet: run perf runs + collect traces (p95 target)
- 16:30 quick check-in with product (model catalog latency expectations)

TODO (quick):
- [ ] add test for edge-case where KV cache misses on first token (unit + integration)
- [ ] update canary runbook with new rollback steps (who does what)
- [ ] ping finance about Dedicated pool billing spike (include example run config)
- [ ] small note for docs: explain why batch size cap is adaptive (one-paragraph)
- [ ] buy birthday gift for Aisha (weekend) — check Etsy + local plant store

Notes / things to remember:
- batching bug: observed duplicate requests when client retries and routing de-duplicates incorrectly; root cause might be dedupe key generation for cross-region routing; reproduce locally using linear script (test/fixtures/retry-dedupe.json).
- prioritization: prod latency SLOs > cost for next two sprints (we need stable p95)
- MVP rollout for mixed precision: ramp 20% -> 50% -> 100% across non-critical regions; fallback to fp32 on regression >= 3% p95

Open questions:
- do we want a per-customer cap on cache size? pros/cons: memory isolation vs. eviction churn. Quick poll w/ infra?
- how soon can Dedicated support soft preemption (graceful CV eviction) — ask platform-eng for ETA

Quick links I need to check today:
- canary dashboard (console): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary-2984
- perf traces folder: gs://redwood-traces/maya/2026-03-04/
- PR w/ batching fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412

Errands (personal):
- dry cleaning (pickup before 6pm)
- buy milk + dog food on way home
- schedule dentist appointment (prefer AM)

Brain dump / short ideas:
- small feature: expose "latency band" header for quick client-side routing decisions (cheap hint) — prototype as header + toggle flag in runtime config
- experiment: record sequence length histogram per model to feed kernel selector; could drive dynamic batch-sizing during the minute (cheap approximation)

Notes to self at EOD:
- aggregate logs of today’s runs into ./bench-results/2026-03-04.csv and slack the p95 numbers to #eng-runtime
- follow up with Evan about test flakiness (CI parallelism differences)

---
Handy reminders: mention the quota number in manager 1:1 (need +2x for Dedicated beta), and add the docs note for adaptive batch cap before asking product for official blurb.
